impact.contract: Uses existing RequestedVerificationRequestSchema without extension; strict outer protected parentRunId/request shape and exact existing accepted response fields. report.version must be preserved by primary integration. Note is private account-protected data; helper never constructs search queries.
impact.persistence: Durable saved identity precedes POST; all awaits guarded. Response loss and rejected acknowledgements keep same pending identity. Accepted response does not clear journal: caller must GET actual child snapshot and durably adopt it before clearing.
impact.boundaries: Primary must gate authenticated ownership, pending verification duplicates, pending admission/source deletion, and account/view changes. Helper receives explicit current guard and validates selected claim/version against caller current owned report.
impact.rollback: Disable new request scheduling while preserving protected pending identities, parsing and explicit retries; never drop unknown admission identity or server required proof obligations. No dependencies/providers/migrations added.
impact.adoption: readVerificationRun validates expected UUID, controlled-research route, labeledDemo false, shared lifecycle/phase/outcome, report UUID, optional brief and correction fields. GET response has no parent/verification identity, so server admission-key resolution remains authoritative linkage; caller rejects parent run and retains pending until durable adoption.
